name.x-prompt: What is the name of the FSD slice?

domain.description: Business domain in kebab-case (catalog, account, shared).
domain.x-prompt: Which business domain does this slice belong to?

layer.description: FSD layer. Prefer pages, features, entities, shared. widgets is discouraged unless this is a true shared UI composition. The app is an Nx application, not a slice.

x-prompt.message: Which FSD layer? Prefer pages/features/entities/shared; widgets only for a true shared composition.

storybook.description: Add a per-slice Storybook target and CSF3 stories. Does not create a workspace host.

unitTestRunner.description: The runner this workspace already uses. The slice gets a tsconfig.spec.json for it. Leave it on none when the workspace has no test runner.
